data.title: Iranian Officials Allowed To Enter US for UNGA
data.transcript_raw:
>> THIS IS "BALANCE OF POWER,"
LIVE FROM WASHINGTON, D.C. JOE: CRUDE AWAKENING.
DIESEL HITS A RECORD HIGH AS CRUDE PRICES REMAIN ELEVATED,
WITH THE TRANSPORTATION SECTOR WARNING OF HIGHER COSTS, AND
WITH NO CLEAR DIPLOMATIC PLAN TO REOPEN THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ
AN ATTACK ON A KEY SAUDI PIPELINE HIGHLIGHTS THE
DIFFICULTY GETTING OIL TO MARKET.
WE SPEAK WITH ALAN ARMSTRONG OF OKLAHOMA ABOUT THE ENERGY
CRUNCH AND WHAT, IF ANYTHING, WASHINGTON CAN DO.
PLUS, HIGHER ENERGY PRICES ARE ADDING TO INFLATION PRESSURES
THE FEDERAL RESERVE IS TRYING TO CONTAIN.
AFTER THE FED RAISED RATES, PRESIDENT TRUMP IS STILL
PUSHING IN THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION, SAYING RATES SHOULD
BE CUT TO 1% OR LOWER. WE SPEAK WITH THE FORMER DEPUTY
DIRECTOR OF THE NATIONAL ECONOMIC COUNCIL IN THE BIDEN
ADMINISTRATION. AND AI ON THE BATTLE -- ON THE
BALLOT. LAWMAKERS ON BOTH SIDES OF THE
BALLOT SENDING SIMILAR WARNINGS AS VOTERS GROW UNEASY ABOUT
ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND THE INFRASTRUCTURE BEHIND IT.
WHAT THAT COULD MEAN FOR THE MIDTERMS AND BEYOND.
FROM BLOOMBERG'S WASHINGTON, D.C.
STUDIOS, WELCOME TO BALANCE OF POWER.
I AM JOE MATHIEU ALONGSIDE KAILEY LEINZ. KAILEY:
THE TRUMP ADMINISTRATION WILL ALLOW IRANIAN OFFICIALS TO
ENTER THE U.S. FOR NEXT WEEK'S U.N.
GENERAL ASSEMBLY. THE ADMINISTRATION APPROVING
VISAS FOR THE CORE DELEGATION EVEN AS THE CONFLICT BETWEEN
THE PARTIES HANGS OVER THE U.N. WE ARE LEARNING MORE ABOUT
TRUMP'S EXPECTED SUMMIT WITH XI JINPING NEXT WEEK.
COURTNEY SUE ROMANIAN IS JOINING US FROM THE WHITE HOUSE
NORTH LAWN WITH MORE. IF WE COULD BEGIN WITH THE
IRANIAN DELEGATION SECURING THEIR VISAS FOR NEXT WEEK,
COULD WE EXPECT TALKS BETWEEN IRAN AND THE U.S.
TO TAKE PLACE ON THE SIDELINES OF THE U.N.? COURTNEY:
EVERYTHING IS POSSIBLE WITH THIS PRESIDENT.
I WOULD NOT GO THAT FAR JUST YET.
WE DID HEAR FROM THE PRESIDENT ABOUT WHERE HIS HEAD IS AT. HE TOLD AXIOS HE IS DECIDING
WHETHER TO RESTART ATTACKS WITH THIS WAR THAT IS AT A
STANDSTILL. THIS COMES BEFORE NEXT WEEK'S
U.N. GENERAL ASSEMBLY WHEN HE IS EXPECTED TO MEET SIX GULF
LEADERS ON THE SIDELINES OF THAT MEETING. THE PRESIDENT WOULD NEED THEIR
SUPPORT IF HE DECIDED TO RESTART MILITARY ACTIONS.
HE TOLD AXIOS HE WANTED TO HEAR THEM OUT.
WE SHOULD EXPECT AN UPDATE AFTER THAT MEETING.
WE KNOW THE PRESIDENT DID SAY IN AUGUST THAT HE HELD OFF ON
RESTARTING ATTACKS AFTER SAUDI ARABIA EXPRESSED CONCERNS ABOUT
RETALIATION. THE QUESTION IS IF HE DOES
DECIDE TO RESUME STRIKES, THE TIMELINE.
WHEN WOULD THAT HAPPEN? WITH THAT COME BEFORE THE
MIDTERM ELECTIONS, GIVEN HOW UNPOPULAR THE WAR IS AND THE
PRESIDENT'S PREVIOUS COMMENTS THAT HE EXPECTS THIS WAR TO END
JUST AFTER THE MIDTERM ELECTIONS?
A LOT GOING INTO THIS MEETING NEXT WEEK. JOE:
THAT IS FOR SURE. AND IT IS ALL A PRELUDE TO THE
BIG MEETING LATER IN THE MONTH WITH PRESIDENT XI.
IT LOOKS LIKE THE WHITE HOUSE IS PULLING OUT THE STOPS.
WE HEARD THE PRESIDENT IS GOING TO MEET X
I AT JOINT BASE ANDREWS, AND JENSEN HUANG, SEVENTH -- SAM
ALTMAN, AND THE CEO OF QUALCOMM WILL BE THERE.
WHAT IS GOING TO COME FROM THE SUMMIT? COURTNEY:
THERE IS LOTS ON THE AGENDA. THE PRESIDENT IS HOLDING HIS
CARDS CLOSE TO HIS CHEST. U.S. OFFICIALS HAVE NOT TELEGRAPHED
TOO MUCH. WE DO KNOW THAT THE U.S.
IS PLANNING TO HOLD OFF ON PLANS TO RELEASE NEW TARIFFS ON
EXCESS MANUFACTURING CAPACITY IN CHINA.
THAT WAS EXPECTED TO BE AROUND 7.5%.
BUT THOSE TARIFFS ARE ON HOLD NOW UNTIL AFTER THE MEETING.
THERE IS LOTS ON THIS AGENDA. WE HAVE TRADE.
WE HAVE IRAN, TAIWAN. BUT ESPECIALLY AI, AS YOU ARE
REFERENCING, WITH THESE TECH LEADERS, MANY OF WHOM WILL BE
IN ATTENDANCE. THERE IS A BIG QUESTION ABOUT
WHETHER THE U.S. AND CHINA CAN REACH AN
AGREEMENT ON AI FRONTIER RISKS, AS WELL AS CYBER SECURITY
CONCERNS. BOTH COUNTRIES HAVE INDICATED
THAT THEY REALLY ARE NOT INTERESTED IN SLOWING DOWN
DEVELOPMENT. BUT THERE IS A QUESTION ABOUT
WHETHER THEY CAN WORK TOGETHER ON SOME FORM OF -- AS THE
TECHNOLOGY CONTINUES TO DEVELOP. I EXPECT THAT WILL BE ONE OF
THE BIG TALKING POINTS. WHETHER THERE IS GOING TO BE
ANY MEANINGFUL BREAKTHROUGHS IS UNCLEAR AS BOTH COUNTRIES
REMAIN LOCKED IN AND AI RACE. JOE:
AI IS GOING TO BE ON THE MENU. IT IS GOOD TO SEE YOU.
THANK YOU SO MUCH. STOCKS MAKING UP FOR SOME OF
YESTERDAY'S FED-INDUCED SELLOFF AS MAJOR INDEXES CLOSE HIGHER
WITH OIL PRICES AND INTEREST RATES PULLING BACK.
WE TURN TO POWER MOVE WITH NORAH MULINDA. NORAH: A BIG REBOUND FROM YESTERDAY'S
FED-DRIVEN SELLOFF. THE S&P AND THE NASDAQ HIGHER
BY 1%. A RISK ON RALLY IN THE MARKET.
THE S&P AND NASDAQ SEEING THEIR BEST DAY IN MORE THAN SIX WEEKS.
TRADERS STACKING UP SHARES WITHIN THE AI SPACE.
LOOK AT THE PHILADELPHIA SEMICONDUCTOR INDEX, HIGHER BY
MORE THAN THREE PERCENT. THE BEST PERFORMING STOCK IN
THE S&P HAS BEEN TIED UP IN THAT AI TRADE.
LOOKING AT SHARES OF THAT COMPANY, REALLY SOARING, UP BY
18% ON THE DAY, GENERAC. THEY WILL BE SUPPLYING BACKUP
GENERATORS TO AMAZON. WE WERE SEEING A LOT OF
INVESTORS RALLY BEHIND THIS COMPANY.
WE HAVE ALSO BEEN KEEPING OUR EYE ON THE BOND MARKET,
ESPECIALLY AS INVESTORS PICK APART WHAT IS GOING ON THERE.
WE DID SEE BONDS CLAWING BACK FROM SOME LOSSES.
YIELDS LOWER BUT STILL REMAINING ELEVATED.
LOOKING AT THE BENCHMARK 10-YEAR TREASURY YIELD, SITTING
JUST BELOW THAT KEY 5% MARK. KAILEY:
AS WE SEE THE MOVE LOWER IN YIELDS, HOW MUCH OF THAT HAS TO
DO WITH THE COOLING OFF OF OIL PRICES IN THE LAST COUPLE OF
DAYS? NORAH: WE SEE BRENT CRUDE PULLING BACK.
BRENT IS SITTING AROUND $104 A BARREL.
WHEN YOU THINK ABOUT CRUDE EASING, THIS IS NOT NECESSARILY
MEANING THAT ALL OF THE ENERGY PRESSURES HAVE DISSIPATED.
HEARING FROM JAMIE HUNT YESTERDAY, THEY EXPECT $10
MILLION TO BE SPENT SPECIFICALLY WHEN IT COMES TO
FUEL PRICES. YOU ARE SEEING A LOT OF OTHER
TRANSPORTATION STOCKS STILL TRYING TO RECOVER FROM WHAT
THIS COULD MEAN FOR THE BROADER INDUSTRY.
WHILE WE ARE SEEING MAY BE SOME OPTIMISM AMID THE SUPPLY
DISRUPTION IN THE MIDDLE EAST THAT COULD BE TEMPORARY, THEY
REMAIN ELEVATED AND THERE IS STILL CONCERNED WHEN WE THINK
ABOUT INFLATION AND WHETHER THE FED IS GOING TO BE ABLE TO REEL
THAT BACK AND. KAILEY: NORAH MULINDA, THANK YOU SO
MUCH. WE WILL STICK ON ENERGY WITH NO
CLEAR OFFRAMP FOR THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ IN THE MIDDLE EAST. HIGH
GAS AND DIESEL PRICES ARE THREATENING TO HIKE UTILITY
BILLS AND OTHER COSTS HEADING INTO THE FALL. WE ASKED THE CHAIR OF ECONOMIC
ADVISORS COUNSEL MEMBER CHRIS PHELAN.
CAN I ASK YOU ABOUT THE RECORD HIGH PRICE WE ARE SEEING FOR
DIESEL ACROSS THE COUNTRY? THIS IS THE FUEL OF SO MANY
PARTS OF THE ECONOMY. IF DIESEL REMAINS ABOVE SIX
DOLLARS A GALLON, WHEN WOULD YOU EXPECT GREATER INFLATIONARY
EFFECTS FROM THAT TO FEEDTHROUGH? CHRIS: THAT IS A VERY TECHNICAL AND
INTERESTING QUESTION. WE DO TEND TO THINK -- TO SEE
THINGS SHOW UP WITH A LAG. WHEN OIL PRICES GO UP, SEVERAL
MONTHS LATER, AIRLINE PRICES GO UP.
THAT KIND OF BLEEDING THROUGH HAS STARTED TO SHOW UP FROM THE
OIL PRICES. AND IT IS A DIFFICULT TECHNICAL
FORECASTING QUESTION THAT REQUIRES MORE EXPERTISE THAN I
CAN GIVE YOU IN THIS SHORT INTERVIEW. KAILEY: FOR MORE ON THE ENERGY CRUNCH,
WE ARE JOINED BY REPUBLICAN SENATOR ALAN ARMSTRONG OF
OKLAHOMA, THE FORMER CEO OF WILLIAMS COMPANIES, JOINING US
LIVE FROM CAPITOL HILL. SENATOR, WELCOME BACK TO
BLOOMBERG TV AND RADIO. I WON'T ASK YOU TO BE AN
ECONOMIST AND ANSWER A TECHNICAL ECONOMIC QUESTION,
BUT YOU ARE AN EXPERT IN THE ENERGY SECTOR.
WHEN YOU LOOK AT DIESEL, WHICH IS AT AN ALL-TIME HIGH, DO YOU
SEE ANY REASON TO BELIEVE THAT THOSE PRICES ARE GOING TO
MATERIALLY COME DOWN IN THE NEAR TERM? SEN. ARMSTRONG:
ALL THINGS ARE VIEWED IN MY EYE THROUGH PERMITTING REFORM.
WHEN YOU GET TO THIS QUESTION, IT SHOULD BE AS WELL.
IF YOU LOOK AT THE SPREAD TODAY BETWEEN DIESEL PRICES IN
OKLAHOMA AND CALIFORNIA, IT IS THREE DOLLARS A GALLON OF
SPREAD. AND THAT SPREAD IS LARGELY
DRIVEN BY EITHER CONSTRAINED INFRASTRUCTURE BECAUSE OF
CALIFORNIA'S DECISION TO NOT SUPPORT FOSSIL FUEL
INFRASTRUCTURE THERE, OR BY THEIR OWN TAXATION.
SO A LOT OF THESE THINGS ARE SELF-INFLICTED.
AND REALLY IF YOU THINK ABOUT THAT THREE DOLLARS A GALLON,
THAT IS ACTUALLY MORE THAN PRICES MOVED IN THE STATE OF
OKLAHOMA FOR A DIESEL PRICE BETWEEN PREWAR AND NOW DURING
THE WAR. SO IT IS FASCINATING TO ME HOW
MUCH GETS THROWN ON TO THIS ISSUE AROUND WAR.
WHAT WE REALLY OUGHT TO BE FOCUSED ON HERE IN THE U.S.
IS WHAT WE CAN DO FOR THE LONG TERM TO MAKE SURE THAT WE HAVE
AFFORDABLE ENERGY BOTH AT THE PUMP, BUT MORE IMPORTANTLY IN
PEOPLE'S UTILITY BILLS. PEOPLE DON'T REALIZE THIS.
YOU SPEND A LOT MORE ON ENERGY AND YOUR UTILITY BILLS THEN YOU
DO ON YOUR GASOLINE, YOUR FUEL, ON AN ANNUAL BASIS.
SO UTILITY BILLS ARE STARTING TO BE THE THING THAT PEOPLE ARE
FOCUSED ON, AND THEY SHOULD BE FOCUSED ON, BECAUSE WHEN YOU
THINK ABOUT PERMITTING REFORM, YOU OUGHT TO THINK THAT IT
MEANS ABUNDANT, LOW-COST ENERGY AVAILABLE AT YOUR HOME.
THAT IS THE KIND OF THING WE SHOULD BE FOCUSED ON HERE IN
THE SENATE. JOE: I WANT YOUR TAKE ON WHAT IS
HAPPENING IN SAUDI ARABIA. HAVING RUN ONE OF THESE
COMPANIES, YOU PROBABLY KNOW MORE ABOUT PIPELINE THAN
ANYBODY ON CAPITOL HILL. REPORTING IN THE WASHINGTON
POST SUGGESTS THE DAMAGE WAS MORE EXTENSIVE THAN WE MAY HAVE
THOUGHT, DAMAGE INFLICTED ON THE EAST/WEST PIPELINE.
THERE WAS A PLUME OF SMOKE SO LARGE IT COULD BE SEEN FROM
SPACE. SECRETARY CHRIS WRIGHT SAYS IT
WILL BE OPERATIONAL IN A MATTER OF DAYS, BUT ANALYSTS WHO HAVE
LOOKED AT IMAGES OF THE PIPELINE -- WE ARE SHOWING SOME
TO OUR VIEWERS ON BLOOMBERG TV -- ANTICIPATE A MUCH LONGER
DISRUPTION. THAT COULD MEAN EVER HIGHER
PRICES. COME CLOSER SAYS IT'S INCREASES
AT THE PUMP FOR BOTH GASOLINE AND DIESEL ARE COMING.
PATRICK DE HAAN OF GAS BUDDY SAYS GAS AND DIESEL ARE SET FOR
A SPIKE IN THE NEXT 48 HOURS, HARDEST IN PARTS OF THE
NATION'S INTERIOR. DO YOU THINK THIS PIPELINE
COULD BE UP AND RUNNING? IF IT STAYS DOWN FOR WEEKS,
WHAT DOES THAT MEAN FOR PRICES? SEN. ARMSTRONG:
OBVIOUSLY, THESE ATTACKS POINT OUT THE IMPORTANCE OF ADEQUATE
INFRASTRUCTURE AND THE IMPACT THAT LACK OF ADEQUATE
INFRASTRUCTURE HAS ON PRICES. IT REALLY KIND OF MAKES THE
POINT. WHAT I WOULD SAY IN TERMS OF
THE TIMING ON A REPAIR, THE FIRST THING THAT HAS TO OCCUR
IS THE AREA HAS TWO FUEL OFF. YOU CANNOT REPAIR THE PIPELINE
WHEN THE GROUND IS CLASSIFIED A LOT OF TIMES BY HEAT FROM THAT
KIND OF FIRE AND EXPLOSION. THAT DOES NOT MEAN YOU CANNOT
ROOT AROUND -- ROUTE AROUND THE SCENE.
WE ARE USED TO THINKING ABOUT PIPELINES TAKING FOREVER TO
BUILD, NOT BECAUSE IT TAKES FOREVER TO BUILD A PIPELINE BUT
BECAUSE IT TAKES FOREVER TO PERMIT A PIPELINE.
THE ACTUAL CONSTRUCTION, SECRETARY WRIGHT IS CORRECT.
THE ACTUAL CONSTRUCTION IS A TWO TO THREE DAY ISSUE.
BUT IT FIRST REQUIRES GETTING THE SITE STABILIZED AND HAVING
A WORK AREA THAT IS BACK TO NORMAL, BECAUSE THERE IS A LOT
OF HEAT THAT HAS BEEN IMPACTED ON THE GROUND THAT HAS TO BE
DEALT WITH. KAILEY:
WHEN YOU CONSIDER THIS NOTION OF POTENTIALLY -- WE HAVE HEARD
ADMINISTRATION OFFICIALS INCLUDING SECRETARY BESSENT
FLOAT THAT THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ IS GOING TO BECOME A WORTHLESS
WATERWAY BECAUSE YOU WERE GOING TO BE ABLE TO PIPELINE AROUND
IT AND GET THE ENERGY OUT THROUGH ALTERNATE ROUTES.
DO YOU SEE THAT BEING NEAR TERM REALITY?
SENATOR, DO WE NEED THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ? SEN. ARMSTRONG: IT IS ALWAYS BETTER FOR
GOVERNMENTS AND FOR PEOPLE TO HAVE MORE INFRASTRUCTURE THEN
YOU NEED. WHEN YOU DO, IT REALLY ELIMINATES -- YOU TAKE GERMANY
AND THE RUSSIAN GAS THAT THEY WERE DEPENDENT ON.
IF THEY ALREADY HAD HAD LNG IMPORT FACILITIES AVAILABLE
INTO THAT AREA, IF THEY HAD REDUNDANT INFRASTRUCTURE IN
THAT AREA, THEY WOULD NOT HAVE BEEN SO CAPTIVE TO THE RUSSIAN
BARGAIN ON THAT. SO I WOULD JUST TELL YOU HAVING
TOO MANY PIPELINES IS VERY GOOD FOR THE PUBLIC, BECAUSE IT
ELIMINATES THESE KIND OF JARS TO THE MARKET WHEN THERE IS
EXCESS INFRASTRUCTURE, AND IT IS EXACTLY WHY WE OUGHT TO BE
TAKING SERIOUSLY PERMITTING REFORM. HAVING TOO MUCH PIPELINE
CAPACITY HERE IS NOT GOOD FOR THE BIG PIPELINE COMPANY, BUT
IT IS GREAT FOR THE PUBLIC. I WOULD JUST SAY, AS WE THINK
ABOUT THE MIDDLE EAST, GETTING ALTERNATIVES BUILT, THE MORE
YOU HAVE OF THAT, THE MORE IT TAKES AWAY THE THREAT OF A
TERRORIST ATTACK, BECAUSE IF YOU HAVE AN ALTERNATE ROUTE, IT
IS NOT GOING TO HOLD THE MARKET HOSTAGE. JOE:
THE MOVE YOU ARE MAKING IN THE AMERICAN ENERGY AND MINERAL
INFRASTRUCTURE ACT -- YOU HAVE REFERRED TO IT A COUPLE OF
TIMES. THERE ARE A COUPLE OF EFFORTS
AT ADDRESSING THIS ISSUE. IT IS PRETTY CLEAR THIS IS THE
REASON WHY YOU ARE IN THE SENATE RIGHT NOW.
IS THIS GOING TO BE SOMETHING HANDLED IN THE LAME-DUCK
SESSION? ARE YOU SETTING THE BASELINE
FOR THE NEXT CONGRESS TO DO THIS? SEVERAL ARMSTRONG:
I'M VERY ENCOURAGED ABOUT WHERE WE STAND TODAY.
THE CROSS SECTOR INDUSTRIES, NOT JUST OIL AND GAS,
PIPELINES, ELECTRIC TRANSMISSION, BUT RENEWABLES,
THE MINING INDUSTRY, HYDROPOWER -- ALL OF THESE SECTORS OF
INDUSTRY HAVE BEEN SPEAKING IN ONE VOICE, WHICH IS WHAT IS
DIFFERENT THIS TIME AROUND THAN WHAT WE HAVE HAD IN PREVIOUS
EFFORTS TO GET PERMITTING DONE. SO PEOPLE ARE SPEAKING IN ONE
VOICE. AND ANOTHER THING THAT HAS
OCCURRED MORE RECENTLY IS PEOPLE HAVE BEGUN TO CONNECT
PERMITTING REFORM WITH THEIR UTILITY BILLS.
SO WE ARE SEEING THAT BECOME AN ISSUE THAT PEOPLE ARE PAYING
ATTENTION TO IN THEIR CONSTITUENCIES, AND PEOPLE ARE
STARTING TO RECOGNIZE HOW IMPORTANT IT IS THAT WE ADDRESS
PERMITTING REFORM FROM A POLITICAL PERSPECTIVE AS WELL.
SO INDUSTRY IS SPEAKING WITH ONE VOICE AND IT IS STARTING TO
BECOME SOMETHING THAT IS NOT JUST A NERDY GUY LIKE MYSELF
THAT HAS BEEN FOCUSED IN THE ENERGY SPACE.
THE AMERICAN PUBLIC ARE STARTING TO REALLY UNDERSTAND
HOW -- WHAT LACK OF INFRASTRUCTURE DOES TO THEIR
UTILITY BILLS. KAILEY: WITH ALL THAT SAID, HAVE YOU
GOTTEN A COMMITMENT FROM THE MAJORITY LEADER, SENATOR THUNE,
THAT THIS WILL BE ON THE FLOOR BEFORE THIS CONGRESS IS OVER?
SIMPLE ARMSTRONG: THERE IS A LITTLE BIT OF
REMAINING WORK TO BE DONE GETTING THE TEXT OUT FROM THE
COMMITTEE LEADS. THEY ARE DOING A FANTASTIC JOB.
I AM REALLY ENCOURAGED BY THE WORK THEY HAVE BEEN DOING.
AND I THINK WHAT WE HAVE GOT TO BE ABLE TO DO, ONE, IS YOU ARE
RIGHT. THE LEADER DOES HAVE TO BE
CONVINCED THAT WE CAN GET THIS PASSED THROUGH THE SENATE.
I THINK WE ARE GETTING CLOSE TO ACCOMPLISHING THAT.
AND WE'VE GOT TO KNOW THAT WE HAVE A PATH THROUGH THE HOUSE,
LIKELY IN A LAME DUCK. AND I AM PERSONALLY WORKING ON
THAT TO MAKE SURE THAT DEMOCRATS IN THE HOUSE ARE
GOING TO BE OUT THERE WITH THEIR VOICE, SAYING HOW
IMPORTANT IT IS FOR THEIR CONSTITUENTS THAT WE GET
PERMITTING REFORM DONE. THOSE ARE KIND OF THE MAIN
ISSUES. BUT I FEEL VERY ENCOURAGED RIGHT NOW THAT WE SHOULD STICK
AROUND THROUGH THE FULL SESSION AND GET PERMITTING REFORM DONE.
I WILL BE VERY DISAPPOINTED IF WE DECIDE THAT IT IS NOT
IMPORTANT ENOUGH TO STICK AROUND TO GET THAT DONE.
BUT I AM FEELING COMPETENT AND I HAVE A LOT OF CONFIDENCE IN
LEADER THUNE AND HIS JUDGMENT. SO I AM FEELING GOOD ABOUT
WHERE WE ARE ON THAT FRONT. BUT WE HAVE GOT TO BE ABLE TO
MAKE SURE HE IS CONFIDENT THAT WE CAN DELIVER A HOUSE RESPONSE
IN A POSITIVE WAY AS WELL. JOE: LET US KNOW WHEN WE FIND OUT.
IT IS GOOD TO HAVE YOU BACK. REPUBLICAN SENATOR ALAN
ARMSTRONG WITH US LIVE ON BLOOMBERG.
COMING UP, THE STATE DEPARTMENT SIGNING OFF ON SELLING DOZENS
OF F 35 FIGHTER JETS TO SAUDI ARABIA, RAISING CONCERNS ABOUT
CLASSIFIED TECHNOLOGY GETTING INTO THE HANDS OF CHINA.
PLUS, WE WILL DIVE INTO THE BIG TAKE ON AMERICA'S TOP DIPLOMAT
AND POTENTIAL 28 CONTENDER. JOE: IT'S "BALANCE OF POWER."
ALONGSIDE KAILEY LEINZ, I'M JOE MATHIEU IN WASHINGTON.
WE LOOK AT A MAJOR EXPANSION OF THE U.S.-SAUDI SECURITY
RELATIONSHIP AS THE STATE DEPARTMENT ANNOUNCES IT PLANS
TO 48 STEALTH FIGHTER JETS IN A DEAL WORTH 24 BILLION DOLLARS.
THIS WOULD MARK THE FIRST SALE OF ONE OF AMERICA'S MOST
ADVANCED FIGHTERS TO AN ARAB NATION IN THE MIDDLE EAST,
RAISING A LOT OF QUESTIONS OVER MILITARY EDGE IN THE REGION,
AND WHETHER THE TECHNOLOGY COULD ULTIMATELY BE EXPOSED TO
CHINA, WHICH HAS ITS OWN RELATIONSHIP WITH RIYADH.
NICK JOINS US FOR MORE. THIS IS SOMETHING WE HAVE
TALKED ABOUT FOR A WILD. WILL IT ACTUALLY HAPPEN? NICK:
GREAT QUESTION. PRESIDENT TRUMP IS SIGNALING
HIS DESIRE TO MAKE THIS HAPPEN FOR A LONG TIME, BUT YOU DID
SEE AN EXAMPLE WHERE THE UNITED ARAB EMIRATES HAD BEEN PROMISED
F-35'S AND THAT ESSENTIALLY GOT STALLED BECAUSE OF THE ISSUES
YOU MENTIONED OVER CHINA, WHERE THE U.S.
SAID, LISTEN, WE WANT TO DO THIS, BUT HERE IS A HOST OF
CONDITIONS WE HAVE TO DO THAT, CHIEFLY TO PREVENT THE
POSSIBILITY OF THIS TECHNOLOGY ESSENTIALLY BEING STOLEN BY
CHINA. THE UAE ULTIMATELY BALKED AND
SAID THIS IS NOT WORTH IT. THE QUESTION IS WHETHER THEY
WILL IMPOSE THOSE CONDITIONS THIS TIME AROUND.
IT WAS THE FIRST TRUMP ADMINISTRATION THAT SET THOSE
CONDITIONS. WILL THEY DO IT THIS TIME?
DEMAND FROM SAUDI ARABIA IS MORE URGENT NOW.
THEY ARE NOT GOING TO GET THESE JETS ANY TIME SOON EVEN IF IT
DOES GO THROUGH. BUT THE SAUDI'S REALLY WANT A
SIGN OF SUPPORT FROM THE UNITED STATES. KAILEY:
THE TIMING IS IMPORTANT. NICK WATERS, THANK YOU SO MUCH.
STAYING ON FOREIGN POLICY, A SPOTLIGHT ON AMERICA'S TOP
DIPLOMAT -- SECRETARY OF STATE MARCO RUBIO.
THE ONETIME POLITICAL RIVAL OF DONALD TRUMP IS NOW ONE OF THE
PRESIDENT'S MOST TRUSTED ADVISORS, A DRIVING FORCE
BEHIND A MASSIVE GLOBAL REALIGNMENT OF BOTH TRADE AND
GEOPOLITICS, KEEPING HIS LONG-HELD VIEWS IN CHECK.
WE ARE JOINED BY ONE OF THE AUTHORS OF THE BIG TAKE.
BLOOMBERG'S ERIC MARTIN IS WITH US.
TAKE US INTO THE WORLD OF MARCO RUBIO. ERIC:
THIS IS A STORY WE HAVE BEEN REPORTING ON FOR A LONG TIME,
LOOKING AT HOW MARCO RUBIO WAS A SENATOR DEEPLY EXPERIENCED ON
FOREIGN POLICY. IN THE SENATE, HE WAS KNOWN FOR
BEING A CHAMPION OF GENEROUS FOREIGN ASSISTANCE, FOR
STANDING UP TO AUTHORITARIAN LEADERS, PARTICULARLY RUSSIA'S
VLADIMIR PUTIN AND CHINA'S XI JINPING, FOR CHAMPIONING GLOBAL
ALLIANCES AROUND THE WORLD INCLUDING NATO.
THE STORY LOOKS AT HOW HE HAS HAD TO SET ASIDE SOME OF THOSE
LONG-HELD BELIEFS TO FOLLOW AND IMPLEMENT AND BECOME A CHAMPION
AND PUBLIC FACE OF PRESIDENT TRUMP'S FOREIGN POLICY.
I ACTUALLY HAD THE OPPORTUNITY TO SPEAK WITH SECRETARY RUBIO.
HE GAVE A RARE INTERVIEW. IT IS RARE THAT HE HAS SPOKEN
TO PRINT REPORTERS IN HIS TIME AS SECRETARY.
WE GOT TO DISCUSS SOME OF THESE THINGS.
WHAT HE SAID TO ME WAS THAT ESSENTIALLY IT IS A DIFFERENT
JOB. YOU ARE IMPLEMENTING THE FOREIGN POLICY OF THE CHIEF
EXECUTIVE. YOUR JOB IS TO FAITHFULLY
IMPLEMENT THAT AND FOLLOW THAT. I ALSO GOT TO SPEAK WITH JOHN
KERRY, ONE OF HIS PREDECESSORS, ALSO A SENATOR AND FORMER
PRESIDENTIAL CANDIDATE, SAID THE SAME THING.
NO MATTER WHAT YOU ESPOUSE WHEN YOU ARE A SENATOR, WHEN YOU ARE
IN THE CABINET, YOU ARE NO LONGER REPRESENTING A STATE OR
CONSTITUENTS IN A SPECIFIC GEOGRAPHY.
YOU ARE THE CHIEF DIPLOMAT AND HAVE TO FAITHFULLY IMPLEMENT
AND FOLLOW THE POLICY THAT IS SET BY THE EXECUTIVE, BY THE
PRESIDENT. JOE: REALLY GREAT WORK.
CONGRATULATIONS ON THE PIECE. THERE IS SO MUCH PEOPLE CAN
FIND ON THE TERMINAL AND OF COURSE AT BUSINESSWEEK.
YOU HAVE BEEN TRAVELING WITH RUBIO SINCE THE BEGINNING OF
THE TERM. OUR AUDIENCE SHOULD KNOW YOU
HAVE BEEN TO 20 COUNTRIES AT THIS POINT.
IS THIS THE TYPE OF SECRETARY OF STATE WHO COULD LAST THROUGH
THE ENTIRE TERM? NICK: WE HAVE SEEN THAT HIS
EFFECTIVENESS IN IMPLEMENTING THE PRESIDENT'S FOREIGN POLICY
HAS WON HIM PLAUDITS FROM THE PRESIDENT.
THE PRESIDENT NEVER MISSES AN OPPORTUNITY TO PRAISE MARCO
RUBIO. IN THE COURSE OF OUR REPORTING,
WE ALSO SPOKE WITH A LOT OF WHITE HOUSE STAFFERS AS WELL AS
MAJOR GOP DONORS, WHO THINK MARCO RUBIO WOULD BE THE
PARTY'S BEST CANDIDATE FOR 2028. WE HAVE SEEN THE PRESIDENT
OFTEN DO THIS IN PUBLIC, WHERE HE WILL TALK ABOUT SHOULD IT BE
JD VANCE OR SHOULD IT BE MARCO RUBIO.
HE WILL KIND OF TAKE A SHOW OF HANDS.
THIS IN FORMAL SOUNDING WITH HIS AUDIENCES, INCLUDING AT
TIMES IN THE WHITE HOUSE ROSE GARDEN OR MAGA EVENTS.
THE PRESIDENT HOLDS HIM IN HIGH ESTEEM. HIS EFFECTIVENESS IN
IMPLEMENTING THE PRESIDENT'S POLICY HAS WON HIM A LOT OF
ATTENTION AND PLAUDITS. THE STORY LOOKS AT WHAT SOME
OUTSIDE GROUPS HAVE SAID, PARTICULARLY ON THE TOPICS OF
THE CUTS TO AND THE RESTRUCTURING OF U.S.
FOREIGN ASSISTANCE, THE TERMINATION OF USAID.
OUTSIDE GROUPS HAVE SAID THIS HAS INCREASED SUFFERING AND
INCREASED DEATH AND HEALTH PROBLEMS GLOBALLY, WHICH IS
SOMETHING THAT SECRETARY RUBIO AND THE ADMINISTRATION REJECT.
THEY WERE BUT THAT. AS WELL AS ON IMMIGRATION AND
THE DEPORTATIONS, ANOTHER CONTROVERSIAL ISSUE. JOE:
IT IS A DEEP DIVE, AND YOU SHOULD TAKE IT. ERIC:
THANK YOU FOR BEING WITH US. KAILEY: THIS IS "BALANCE OF POWER."
ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IS DRAWING RARE BIPARTISAN
AGREEMENT IN WASHINGTON. LAWMAKERS ON BOTH SIDES OF THE
AISLE, INCLUDING REPUBLICANS LIKE LAWLER AND REPUBLICANS
LIKE KRISHNAMURTHY, MADE THE SAME CASE ON BALANCE OF POWER
THIS WEEK. AI MEETS -- NEEDS GUARDRAILS. >> THERE NEEDS TO BE A WHOLE OF
GOVERNMENT APPROACH IN HOW WE HANDLE THIS.
IT DOES REQUIRE THE FEDERAL GOVERNMENT PUTTING IN PLACE
STANDARDS. >> IF WE DO THIS IN A SMART WAY
WITH GOOD GUARDRAILS TO PROTECT PEOPLE AND ENSURE THAT WE ALSO
CAN BE COMPETITIVE. >> SHOULD WE BE TALKING ABOUT
SOMETHING CYBORG SO WE ARE MAKING SURE WE HAVE CONTROL OF
THIS? I THINK THOSE ARE HEALTHY CONVERSATIONS. >> I AM HOPEFUL WE ARE GOING TO
SEE ACTION. NOW, MORE THAN EVER, WE HAVE TO
MAKE THIS OCCUR. I THINK THIS IS ON THE BALLOT,
FRANKLY, FOR NOVEMBER. KAILEY: DIFFERENT PARTIES, DIFFERENT
